how: We read the website of every Denver wedding DJ listed on Lazo (62 listings, 44 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: national DJ franchises with a Denver landing page, a Phoenix DJ with a Colorado listing, a live band, a karaoke host, and silent-disco and DIY jukebox rentals. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Does my venue have a noise curfew or a power limit? Outdoor and mountain venues often do; ask what the DJ needs for power and what happens after the cutoff.
Who exactly will DJ my wedding, and can I talk to that person before I sign?
What is in the base price, and what are ceremony audio, uplighting, a photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Altitude Beats – Silent Disco, Wedding DJ & Events
picks.blurb: A Denver wedding DJ team with a bilingual MC and silent disco as a signature option, based in Centennial. Altitude Beats describes its approach as client-centered and culturally inclusive, with pro sound and dynamic lighting for weddings, corporate events and private parties.

picks.name: Ignight Entertainment
picks.blurb: Founded in 2013 by husband-and-wife creatives Mike and Amber Handby, Ignight is an artist-led entertainment house that blends music, performance and technology. The site talks about energy, transitions and momentum as the craft, for celebrations that feel connected and playful.

picks.name: Mountain Event Services
picks.blurb: Matt Kays has been DJing since 1996 and founded Mountain Event Services in 2013, growing it into a Fort Collins team that handles weddings, corporate parties and teen events. The wedding page promises a soundtrack that speaks to you rather than background music.

picks.name: Stag Entertainment
picks.blurb: Stag Entertainment claims more than 3,000 events across Denver and Phoenix over ten-plus years, with DJs, photo booths and event lighting under one roof. They call themselves event experience specialists rather than a DJ company, and run the two markets to one standard.

picks.name: TH Entertainment
picks.blurb: TH Entertainment has done DJ and MC services for weddings since 2010, starting every booking with an exploratory call about your vision and then matching you with one of its DJs. Pricing comes after a consultation, not from a menu.

picks.name: HOWE EVENTFUL | Entertainment & Event Solutions
picks.blurb: Brian Howe, a DJ and producer, founded Howe Eventful in 2017 after fellow vendors kept referring clients to him. The Loveland company offers mobile DJ and emcee services, live musicians, silent disco and a photo booth, and promises to hand-hold the client through the whole process.

picks.name: Tier Two Live
picks.blurb: Tier Two Live began in 2019 as an independent all-ages music promotion group and now does DJ and MC services, live music production and event planning across East Boulder County and the Front Range. The site says it is equally at home with 25 guests or 300-plus.

picks.name: Mile High Vibes Entertainment, LLC
picks.blurb: A family-owned DJ and lighting business run by husband and wife Jesse and Sheena Gillmore out of Englewood. Jesse has more than 20 years behind the decks, starting on Technics 1200 turntables, and the pair start working with you from the moment you book.

picks.name: DJ Guy Disc Jockeys
picks.blurb: Locally owned and family operated, DJ Guy says it has provided music for more than 10,000 weddings and events in the Denver area over nearly 20 years. The site offers an instant quote and an LED dance floor rental, and pitches personalized entertainment at an affordable price.

picks.name: Elite Entertainment
picks.blurb: Elite Entertainment's Denver crew works to a set of values it calls R.I.S.E., for reliability, integrity, simplicity and experience. Your DJ doubles as the event host, with photo booth and event lighting offered by the same team.

picks.name: Discosapien
picks.blurb: Discosapien is a wedding and event DJ service that is also a DJ and music production academy, a record label and a recording studio, based in Denver and Westminster. Photo booths are available, and pricing comes by welcome email after a contact form.

picks.name: Moon Magnet DJ Productions
picks.blurb: Moon Magnet has been packing Denver dance floors since 2013 and lists a Westword Best of Denver 2026 win and back-to-back Best of Zola wins. DJ, MC, sound and lighting from one company, with a free consultation to start.
